watchPoints.text: Watch Driveonwill at the early fences — two unseatings in recent form (44-U1U) in a 19-runner field over fences could cause interference throughout the pack; if he skews or departs early, it fundamentally changes the race shape.

Monitor Sampoet's jumping closely — as the lone front-runner he controls the pace entirely, and any mistake or significant blunder will immediately compress the field and alter tactical positions for the prominent group behind him.

Fr Gilligansvoyge has strong recent form (win last time, excellent good-ground record 14/15) and an in-form trainer — worth tracking from the midfield pack as a potential each-way danger despite being a genuine hold-up horse racing out of his preferred position.

L'Amiral Fromentin's three-day turnaround is the shortest in the field; watch for any signs of a stilted warm-up or market drift that might signal the yard is simply using the run as a prep rather than going for the win.

With six genuine hold-up horses redistributed to midfield positions, the early stages could be unusually crowded in the middle of the pack — watch the first two fences for bunching and whether horses like King's Son and Tingarran Express can travel freely or get blocked.

runners_data.name: Boston Common
runners_data.comment: Hard to recommend on the form available, returning after a long absence without worthwhile evidence to assess. Shows a second among his recent results but the overall picture is thin and he is ranked 11th on our figures.

runners_data.name: Go Away
runners_data.comment: A Getaway gelding on debut today with no form to go on, half-brother to Mollie De Mai who was below her best at this kind of trip. Pedigree gives limited encouragement at today's distance; hard to assess.

runners_data.name: Highlander Addict
runners_data.comment: Third at Tramore 35 days ago, beaten 2.5 lengths in a ladies bumper on ground he handles, and showing steady improvement across his starts. Effective at this distance on good to yielding; a genuine danger here on our second-highest rating in the field.

runners_data.name: Loughtown
runners_data.comment: Out the back and outpaced throughout in an auction bumper at Naas on his most recent start, and has not placed in his last two outings. Returning after a 200-day absence makes this a difficult one to recommend.

runners_data.name: Martymill
runners_data.comment: Second in a bumper at Listowel 32 days ago, beaten 3 lengths, and the distance suits him on ground he handles. Tries first-time cheekpieces today; a developing prospect who has yet to score but shaped with promise on that effort.

runners_data.name: Minnatrix
runners_data.comment: Lost his footing in a bumper at Listowel 32 days ago and had earlier fallen, but shaped with promise when runner-up before those mishaps. Handles this going and acts at 2m; the bumper form is not extensive but the ability looks to be there.

runners_data.name: Poet's Sonnet
runners_data.comment: Beaten out of contention on his only start, a maiden at Dromahane, and has everything to do on that evidence. Ranked 13th on our figures and hard to recommend at this stage.

runners_data.name: Tale Of Intrigue
runners_data.comment: Third in a bumper at Kilbeggan 18 days ago, beaten 3 lengths, and handles this going. Inexperienced with much still to prove, but that effort showed promise and he merits a place in calculations as a midfield contender.

runners_data.name: Orderly Conduct
runners_data.comment: A son of Order Of St George making his racecourse debut; there is nothing to assess from his form to date. Pedigree interest exists but he is last on our figures and entirely on trust here.

runners_data.name: Cotswold Blue
runners_data.comment: Shaped with ability when placed second in a mares bumper at Tramore 34 days ago, beaten 5 lengths on her only start, and handles this trip and going. Top-rated on our figures and tries a first-time hood; she warrants plenty of respect stepping forward here.

runners_data.name: Mistakenforanother
runners_data.comment: Placed second in a bumper at Kilbeggan 18 days ago, beaten 2.5 lengths, having gained from the debut experience before that. Effective at this distance and handles this going; improvement is expected from a mare who is still finding her feet.

runners_data.name: Perfect Order
runners_data.comment: A Nirvana Du Berlais mare making her debut with no form to judge; connections include a top trainer which adds some interest to an otherwise blank page. Hard to assess and entirely on trust from the market.

runners_data.name: Speisialta
runners_data.comment: Fourth on her only start at Punchestown, beaten 24 lengths, racing too freely and failing to see out the trip under a hood. Effective at 2m with cut in the ground, but improved composure will be key; she returns after 172 days away.

runners_data.name: False Dawn
runners_data.comment: Third on debut at Punchestown 26 days ago, beaten 4 lengths in a mares bumper, running freely but staying on. Handles this trip and going, with more to come as she settles — a genuine danger to the selection if she can repeat that level.

runners_data.name: Ballybollen
runners_data.comment: A 7,000gns Nathaniel gelding making his debut with no form to assess, half-brother to Mongibello who showed smart form at 20 furlongs. A top trainer adds interest but he is unproven and last on our figures.

runners_data.name: Optical Illusion
runners_data.comment: Two pulls-up in his limited starts show no worthwhile form to date, and he returns from a short break having given no indication of ability. Ranked 17th on our figures and very hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: S T Hamo
runners_data.comment: Sixth in a bumper at Kilbeggan 49 days ago and likely needing that run, his debut effort having since been put in context. Handles today's trip and going and tries a first-time tongue-tie; not without ability but needs to show more.
